Definition: Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gemariah = "Jehovah has accomplished"; 1) the son of Shaphan the scribe and father of Michaiah; one of the nobles of Judah who had a chamber in the temple from which Baruch read Jeremiah's alarming prophecy to all the people; 2) the son of Hilkiah who bore Jeremiah's letter to the captive Jews
